import json, hashlib
from p513_solve_profile_guard import SolveProfileGuard
G = SolveProfileGuard(permitted=(), label='W104 K2 uncertified comparison (never solves)').install()
import settling_criterion as SC
C = 'data/SRP1/Results/P515S53/w101_srp1_continuation/campaign_s53_w101_srp1_cont_c_star/'
E = C + 'evals/4bf36c151fd10613_c_star/'
LR = 'data/SRP1/Results/P515S53/w104_literal_reading/w104_literal_reading.json'
rows = [json.loads(l) for l in open(E + 'per_cycle_record.jsonl')]
q = {r['cycle']: r['gross_operational_cost'] for r in rows}
dec = json.load(open(E + 'settling_decision.json'))
sr = json.load(open(C + 'campaign_results.json'))['settling_report']
ind = json.load(open(LR))['cells']['c_star']['K2_independent_rederivation']['independent']
N, K = 87, rows[-1]['cycle']
L_MONO = json.load(open(C + 'campaign_spec_s53_w101_srp1_cont_c_star_1a7483ef.json'))['candidates'][0]['settling_continuation']['settling_rule']['l_mono']
assert L_MONO == 2 * 22
bw = dec['band_window']; vals = [q[c] for c in range(bw[0], bw[1] + 1)]
band = [min(vals), max(vals)]
mono = [q[c] for c in range(K - L_MONO + 1, K + 1)]
cmp = {'T': json.dumps(ind['T']) == json.dumps(dec['T']), 'A': json.dumps(ind['A']) == json.dumps(dec['A']),
       'k0': ind['k0'] == dec['k0'], 'no_lapse_after_N': ind['lapse_cycles_after_N'] == [] and dec['lapse_events'] == [],
       'band_window_is_last_20': bw == [K - 19, K] and dec['band_window_length'] == 20,
       'band': band == dec['band'], 'band_width': band[1] - band[0] == dec['band_width'],
       'Q_at_cap': q[K] == sr['Q_at_cap'], 's_signed': q[K] - q[N] == sr['s_signed'],
       'mid_band_minus_Q_N': (band[0] + band[1]) / 2 - q[N] == sr['report_only']['mid_band_minus_Q_N'],
       'Q_N_eq_decision': q[N] == dec['Q_N'],
       'fewer_than_3_turning_points': len(ind['T']) < 3,
       'monotone_window_range_gt_tau': max(mono) - min(mono) > SC.TAU}
out = {'what': 'W104 zero-solve K2 comparison for the UNCERTIFIED c_star decision (the W103 script reports but does not '
               'compare K2 when uncertified): independent T/A/k0 from w104_literal_reading.json vs settling_decision.json; '
               'band over band_window recomputed from raw Q; s = Q_cap - Q_N; mid(band) - Q_N; monotone window '
               '[K - L_MONO + 1, K] range vs TAU',
       'code': open(__file__).read(),
       'inputs': {p: hashlib.sha256(open(p, 'rb').read()).hexdigest() for p in
                  (E + 'per_cycle_record.jsonl', E + 'settling_decision.json', C + 'campaign_results.json', LR, 'settling_criterion.py')},
       'values': {'band': band, 'band_width': band[1] - band[0], 'range_over_tau_band': (band[1] - band[0]) / SC.TAU,
                  's_signed': q[K] - q[N], 'mid_band_minus_Q_N': (band[0] + band[1]) / 2 - q[N],
                  'monotone_window': [K - L_MONO + 1, K], 'monotone_range': max(mono) - min(mono),
                  'monotone_range_over_tau': (max(mono) - min(mono)) / SC.TAU, 'TAU': SC.TAU},
       'comparisons': cmp, 'all_agree': all(cmp.values())}
out['guard'] = {'counts': dict(G.counts), 'verify_0_failures': G.verify(0)}
assert not out['guard']['verify_0_failures']
import gate_result_io as GRIO
with open('data/SRP1/Results/P515S53/w104_literal_reading/w104_k2_uncertified_check.json', 'x') as fh:
    GRIO.dump(out, fh, indent=1, sort_keys=True, default=GRIO.json_default)
print(json.dumps(out['comparisons']), out['all_agree'], json.dumps(out['values']), out['guard'])
